preconditions.description: The number of arguments n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i in {0, 1} for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each argument a_i must be either 0 or 1.
The length of the list of arguments must equal n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any(a_i == 1 for a_i in a) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no 1s in the input, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a_i == 1 for a_i in a) else True
postconditions.description: If there is at least one 1 in the input, output 'YES'.
The total number of characters in the output expression must not exceed 1,000,000.
